scenes.text: On a 1–100 chart, what number is one square to the right of 27? Let us think carefully. On a standard hundred chart, to the right of 27 is 28. The answer is 28. Great work!
On a 1–100 chart, what number is one square to the left of 43? Let us think carefully. On a standard hundred chart, to the left of 43 is 42. The answer is 42. Great work!
On a 1–100 chart, what number is one square below of 66? Let us think carefully. On a standard hundred chart, below of 66 is 76. The answer is 76. Great work!
On a 1–100 chart, what number is one square above of 52? Let us think carefully. On a standard hundred chart, above of 52 is 42. The answer is 42. Great work!
